Abstract. In the context of Industry 4.0, effective monitoring of multiple targets
and states during assembly processes is crucial, particularly when constrained to
using only visual sensors.

detection methods to detect and provide real-time feedback on errors during assembly
stages. The key technologies and concepts involved include digital image processing,
deep learning, filtering algorithms, stereo vision, finite state machines, Qt, and more.
